description: CSV convert. A CSV document in, URL-encoded as the csv query parameter (up to 12,000 bytes), a conversion out: RFC 4180 parsing (quoted fields, escaped quotes, newlines in quotes), delimiter sniffing among comma, semicolon, pipe, and tab, a JSON records array keyed by header, and a rendered Markdown table of the same rows, with every statistic included. Price: $0.10 per call, paid in USDC on Base mainnet over x402; an unpaid call answers HTTP 402 with the exact machine-readable payment terms.

csv.description: The CSV document to convert (up to 12,000 bytes).

name: csv-convert
